import torch

SHAPES = [
    (1,),
    (64, 64),
    (4096, 4096),
    (64, 256, 256),
    (16, 128, 64, 32),
]

def gen_inputs(axes, device):
    idx = axes.get("shape_id", 0)
    shape = SHAPES[idx]
    return {"input_0": torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)}

def run(input_0, output):
    result = torch.nn.functional.gelu(input_0)
    output.copy_(result)
